system.name: τ²-bench
system.one_liner: Benchmark of conversational agents in a dual-control telecom environment where agent and simulated user both use tools on a shared world.

content.variant_note: two parallel lanes for agent and user, each with instruction, tools and database, joined by a cycle arrow and framed by one shared World outline
content.argues: The agent is not alone in the world: the user also holds tools and a database, so agent and user must coordinate to change the shared state.
content.subject: Agent and user each with an instruction card, tools and a database, inside one shared World.

lessons.what_to_learn: Show a two-party environment as two parallel lanes with the same four slots (instruction card, party icon, tool card with a real code listing, database card with real fields), and enclose the databases in one titled outline so the shared world is visible.
lessons.suits: Agent or interactive-environment benchmarks that must show who can act on what: agent versus user, client versus server, with their tools and state.

evidence: As illustrated in Figure 1, the Dec-POMDP in τ 2-bench involves two players: an agent and a user.
the user is simulated by another AI agent given a scenario-based instruction and a set of tools
where both agent and user make use of tools to act in a shared, dynamic environment

summary: τ²-bench evaluates conversational agents in a dual-control environment where both the agent and a simulated user use tools on a shared world. Figure 1 draws this as two parallel lanes. In the top lane a light-blue 'Agent Domain Policy' card feeds a robot icon labelled Agent, whose peach 'Agent Tools' card shows a READ tool as monospace code and links by a double-headed arrow to an 'Agent DB' card with customer fields. The bottom lane mirrors it with a pink 'User Instruction' card, a user avatar, 'User Tools' (a WRITE tool, toggle_airplane_mode) and 'User DB' with device fields. A black circular-arrows icon links agent and user, and a green rounded outline titled World encloses both databases with green circular arrows.
summary_zh: τ²-bench 的双控环境图：上下两条泳道分别是智能体（领域策略、READ 工具、客户数据库）和用户（指令、WRITE 工具、设备数据库），两者之间有黑色循环箭头，两个数据库被绿色“World”轮廓框成共享世界。
notes: The printed figure has large blank margins above and at the sides of the drawing. The circular-arrows icons are unlabelled; their readings (agent-user interaction, changing shared state) come from the caption and abstract. The instruction text in the card reads 'You mobile data is not working properly' (typo in the figure). Strokes are absent in the SVG, so cards have no outlines.
